description: Flown from England to Australia between 2 March and 13 May 1990 by Dr Brian Edwards to raise money for Legacy. Substantially damaged in a 1995 accident, withdrawn from use and cancelled from the register on 20 June 2005; displayed in a hangar at the Edwards family winery near Margaret River.
aliases: DH82; DH82A; Tiger Moth; c/n DHA1375
